parsed.reason: The code does write metadata via atomic replace before the blob, so a failed blob write (e.g., disk full in tmp.write_bytes) would leave the old blob with new metadata, a real consistency defect that causes wrong metadata to be served. The leftover temp files on failure are also a genuine, if minor, issue.
